projects.title: AI Career Skill Gap Intelligence Platform
projects.description: An AI-powered career intelligence system that parses resumes, predicts suitable job roles using ML, and detects skill gaps through a hybrid exact + semantic (FAISS) + rule-based matching engine. It then uses an LLM to generate personalized advice, recommendations, and a phase-wise learning roadmap.
features: 3-layer skill gap engine (Exact + Semantic FAISS + Rule-based)
Interactive dashboard with charts & trend visualization

projects.title: Sentiment aware recommendation system using NLP
projects.description: A hybrid AI recommendation system that understands Hinglish, typos, and natural queries — using intent detection, sentiment (TF-IDF) and emotion analysis (DistilRoBERTa) to rank smartphones with a multi-factor weighted scoring engine.
features: Multi-layer intent detection (spell correction, semantic similarity, zero-shot classification)
Sentiment analysis via TF-IDF + Logistic Regression
Emotion detection using DistilRoBERTa (joy, anger, fear, etc.)
Weighted multi-factor product ranking (rating, sentiment, emotion, feature match, brand)
FastAPI backend with React frontend for real-time recommendations

projects.title: Heart Disease SurvivalPrediction Model
projects.description: A machine learning pipeline for heart disease prediction that tackles class imbalance and interpretability using SMOTE+ENN hybrid sampling, cost-sensitive XGBoost/Random Forest, RFE+SHAP feature selection, and an ensemble voting classifier — tuned via GridSearchCV/Optuna.
features: SMOTE + ENN hybrid sampling for class imbalance
Hybrid RFE + SHAP feature selection for interpretability
Evaluation via Sensitivity, G-mean, ROC-AUC & MCC

projects.title: RAG Chatbot
projects.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation chatbot capable of answering user queries using vector search and LLMs.

projects.title: LLM-Based Chatbot
projects.description: An AI chatbot powered by Large Language Models with conversational memory and intelligent response generation.
